embeds.title: 🔴 Packagist Supply Chain Attack Infects 8 Packages with Malicious Code
embeds.description:
Socket reports a coordinated supply chain attack campaign impacting eight packages on Packagist. The malicious code was inserted into package.json files (not composer.json) targeting projects with JavaScript build tooling alongside PHP code. The attack involved postinstall scripts designed to download a Linux binary from a GitHub Releases URL, save it to /tmp/.sshd, grant execute permissions, and run it in the background. Socket's investigation found references to the same payload across 777 files in GitHub, suggesting a broader campaign. The affected packages have been removed from Packagist.
**Sources:** thehackernews.com • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Supply chain attack via compromised package repositories on Packagist
**Incident date:** 2026-05-23 • **Confidence:** claim
